messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Gabapentin can cause life-threatening breathing problems (respiratory depression), especially if you already have a breathing disorder (such as COPD), are elderly, or if you use other medicines that can make you drowsy or slow your breathing, such as opioids or CNS depressants. Seek emergency medical attention if you have very slow breathing.
Suicidal thoughts or behaviors. Some people have thoughts about suicide while taking and after discontinuing this medicine. Stay alert to changes in your mood or symptoms. Tell your doctor right away if you have any sudden changes in mood or behavior, or thoughts about suicide.
Abrupt or rapid discontinuation. Seizures may occur if you stop using gabapentin suddenly. Ask your doctor before stopping the medicine. Stopping abruptly can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, trouble sleeping, nausea, pain, and sweating.

Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
